title: Correction
description: Structured human-in-the-loop correction raised against an upstream domain entity (source, canonical document, or commentary insight). Corrections are the durable audit trail for HITL edits, annotations, rejections, and rescore requests; downstream projections rebuild from upstream entities and do not carry their own corrections.

target_entity_type.description: Domain entity family this correction targets. Search projections are derived/rebuildable and are not a valid target — corrections target the upstream entity and the projection rebuilds.

target_entity_id.description: Identifier of the targeted entity. Must match the family implied by target_entity_type (src_*, doc_*, ins_*).

correction_type.description: Kind of correction. field_edit replaces field values; annotation attaches operator notes; reject marks the entity unfit; rescore_request asks the pipeline to re-process or re-rank.

payload.description: Free-form correction payload. The shape is intentionally open in v1 of the contract; per-correction_type schemas may be tightened in a follow-up minor once admin and pipeline consumers stabilize.

original_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the targeted fields prior to the correction, when applicable. Null for corrections that do not modify existing fields (e.g. rescore_request, pure annotation).

pipeline_run_id.description: Pipeline run that produced the correction, when raised by an automated quality gate. Null for human-raised corrections.

rationale.description: Human-readable rationale for the correction. Optional but strongly encouraged; required by review policy at the application layer for `reject` and `field_edit`.

status.description: Lifecycle state. The application layer enforces legal transitions: pending → applied | rejected; applied → superseded.

created_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp when the correction was raised.

applied_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp when status transitioned to `applied`. Null for pending, rejected, or superseded corrections.
